tokens.v: The pair sits on the polished brass luggage rack of a sleeper-train compartment, toes toward the window, laces swaying with the carriage while the world outside streaks into long amber and teal light trails. 50mm at f/1.8 level with the rack, the window filling the frame behind, a warm cabin lamp on mahogany panelling below, a folded wool coat blurring in the lower-right corner cut by both edges. Leather grain and welt stitching sharp in the lamp light; a shallow unlettered maker's deboss in the sole sidewall catches the passing lights.
